system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: For each target defect type, specific additional instructions are appended to the prompt as context information.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-defect-type prompts with Timon report and context appended; could be dynamically_composed. Paper only.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: In the last mode, skills with the highest semantic similarity to steps in the natural language instructions are appended as additional context.
env_context_strategy.note: Skill Chooser; other modes: all skills, exact match. Third mode chosen by default. Mechanism of similarity not stated as embeddings.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config surface for history handling.

observation_format.evidence_quote: incorporating Timon's report of detected defects as direct feedback
observation_format.note: Format of report text not specified.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the FM in this component is prompted to generate the corresponding workflow as a valid JSON object that adheres to theWorkflowDSLgrammar
tool_call_format.note: Output is a JSON DSL workflow, not tool calls; closest value.

tool_count.note: No model-invoked tools described; paper only.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: repairing a defective DSL can also be considered as re-synthesizing the program
edit_primitive.note: Repair appears to regenerate whole workflow.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schema; skills listed with name/IO/description in prompt.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; MCP mentioned only as related work.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: after each repair attempt byPumbaa, the target workflow is re-examined by the static analyzer to verify whether all original defect incidences are resolved
loop_primitives.note: NL-2-DSL pipeline (refinement -> synthesis) then Timon/Pumbaa verify-repair loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: we prompt the FM to generate the task nodes of the workflow in the same order as the steps outlined in the natural- language instructions
planning_granularity.note: Step-by-step instructions from AlignMind guide synthesis; not stored as plan object by harness.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: which consists of two main parts:Requirements Refinement A andDSL Workflow Synthesis B

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the corrected DSL program is sent back toTimonto continue the defect detection process
delegation_mechanism.note: Fixed hand-off between stages; closest value.

human_in_loop.note: AlignMind interacts with users for refinement; fallback to users only suggested ('the system should defer to end users'). No gating mechanism described.

long_term_memory.note: Skills database is environment, not memory; paper only.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we propose incorporating the results report of the static analyzer as a direct feedback mechanism in a FM-based correction module, to iteratively repair detected defect incidences
self_verification.note: Timon static analyzer (JSON parse, Pydantic DSL validation, use-def analysis).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: we set the maximum count of repair attempts for each defect type to ten
retry_policy.note: Until all defects of type repaired or cap reached; recommended six in practice.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: till all reported incidences for the target defect type are repaired or the maximum count of repair attempts is exhausted

execution_isolation.note: Execution environment described but isolation not stated.

replayability.note: Replication package of data/prompts, not replay facility.

guardrails.evidence_quote: If the FM-generated DSL workflow cannot be parsed into a valid JSON or the instantiated DSL program does not follow the grammar,Timonrecords a defect incident
guardrails.note: Workflow validation before execution; paper only.

target_domain.evidence_quote: reliably generate FM- powered workflows that meet user-provided requirements, regardless of domain

open_source.note: Only data/prompts released on figshare; no code licence in evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we use and compare the repair performance of three different families of models including OpenAI's GPT-4o-2024-08-06
model_agnostic.note: Quote apostrophe may differ; GPT-4o, Llama, Qwen used.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Analyzed FM-generated DSL workflows, ground-truth defect annotations, analysis results, and the prompts used during experiments are made available online for replicability.

first_release_date.note: arXiv 2509.25117 v1 date not in evidence (v2 17 Mar 2026).
